patch.value: Verify closeout evidence and detect gamed gates
Independently evaluate acceptance criteria against fresh linked tests, linked artifacts, comments and change baselines. Emit compact verdicts without closing items.

Closeout reports each criterion with concrete evidence and fails closed on gaps; detects weakened gates and skipped focused deleted or ineffective tests; supports plain trackers and optional isolated behavioral revert checks; demonstrates three merged fleet items and a seeded gamed change; unchanged npm and Bun release gates pass

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap checked: pm help exposes linked-test execution but no independent criterion verification; pm-ops verify-release executes package gates and assurance measures thresholds; pm-lint validates context quality and explicitly does not certify evidence; pm-context assembles handoff evidence. pm-review owns the independent closeout verdict. Design: conservative criterion binding to fresh named test results, typed gate findings, git baseline or recorded linked-file state, isolated optional source revert. No automatic closure.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Initial behavioral acceptance now passes: a plain tracker proves a named criterion from a fresh run and becomes sensitive after source-only restore; a vacuous passing test is flagged source_unexecuted and revert_survived. Source item bytes remain unchanged. The pinned host rejects universal read-output controls on test mutations; the runner omits those controls. Full release coverage and three merged-item demonstrations are next.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Three exact-merge read-only demonstrations complete: PR 16 round-exit-contract: 2 unproven (120-second test budget exceeded); PR 15 f82w: 2 unproven (no linked tests); PR 12 respond: 16 unproven (combined original linked commands exceeded 120 seconds). All refuse closeout, preserve original criteria and leave tracked source state unchanged. Seeded vacuous test returns source_unexecuted and revert_survived; legitimate no-git evidence proves its criterion. Details: docs/closeout-dogfood.md. Continuing unchanged-threshold release gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral proofs passed in disposable source copies: disabling only detectGaming caused its regression to fail (exit 1, assertion failure); disabling only checkInvocation caused the real-tracker vacuous-test regression to fail (exit 1, missing source_unexecuted). Original source untouched. Packed npm/npx and native Bun/bunx acceptance passed 1/1, including closeout JSON/TOON success and unproven exit 1. Added detached-descendant timeout regression and recognition for Node spec/Bun stderr assertions. Release checks remain pending.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Fresh linked pm test execution passes 2/2 commands after clearing the inherited PM_SOURCE_WORKSPACE_ROOT in the disposable child host. The nested host previously selected the outer workspace instead of the copy. The regression injects a wrong outer workspace and also removes git from PATH. The tracker has test-result-tracking disabled, so the PM run returns tracking_disabled rather than persisting a test_runs row; this comment records the observed result without changing project policy.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: First full npm release check measured every authored source at 100 percent statements, branches, functions and lines and zero duplication, but failed the pre-existing classifier wall-clock assertion: 63.60046 ms versus the unchanged 50 ms limit. The isolated single-test rerun passed 1/1. This is not a passing release gate. Bun and isolated-HOME runs on code commit 92f1c29 are pending; a complete npm rerun will retain the same thresholds.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Bun source coverage passed 150/150 with 100 percent in all four dimensions; later release stages are still running. The isolated-HOME source suite passed 149/150 and exposed an immediate-process-state race in the new SIGKILL regression. The test now observes bounded eventual termination (at most two seconds), without changing runtime code, the cleanup deadline, classifier limit or coverage floors. It still fails if the detached descendant remains live. Targeted cleanup regression passes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Correction to the preceding note: the first targeted cleanup invocation failed because a broad import replacement also modified generated fixture strings, and the shell continued into the note and commit. That failed invocation is not passing evidence. Fixture strings are now corrected; build:test and the targeted detached-descendant cleanup regression both pass. Future evidence-recording command sequences fail immediately on a failed check. Original append-only history is retained.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Added and passed two real-tracker copy regressions: canonicalize a symlink workspace root before preparing the disposable copy, and refuse external artifact symlinks in source/tracker snapshots. Disabling only the new artifact-link guard in a separate source copy makes the refusal regression fail with an assertion error (exit 1). TypeScript test build, lint and zero-duplication checks pass. Final gates are restarted for this runtime change; previous candidate gates are not approval for this head.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI reproduced a real installed-consumer gap: PM-managed extensions contain a node_modules SDK peer symlink, and the artifact-link guard incorrectly refused that declared dependency. A real-tracker dependency-link regression failed before the fix (exit 1, assertion error) and now passes, together with workspace-alias and external-artifact refusal regressions (3/3). The tracker snapshot preserves links only within managed extension node_modules; artifact links remain refused. Build:test, lint and zero duplication pass. Final packed acceptance and all release gates are being rerun; prior and canceled checks are not approval.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Revised focused suite passes 24/24 with zero skipped tests. Positive fixtures now use the production-default 60-second execution budget: full-source concurrent runs exceeded their artificial 20-second fixture budget. Dedicated deadline/output-limit regressions, the existing 50 ms classifier limit, and all coverage/lint thresholds are unchanged. Latest standalone packed npm/native-Bun acceptance passes 1/1 on local Bun 1.3.5; CI uses Bun 1.4.3 and still refuses preparation in its native-Bun consumer. An isolated matching Bun runtime is being used for diagnosis; no host runtime was replaced. Failed and incomplete release runs remain non-approval.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The matching Bun 1.4.3 runtime and fresh installed consumers pass locally, including a Node 26 linked command, while CI still reports a preparation refusal. Added bounded preparation phase/error categories to identify the failing stage without exposing paths or raw output. Pure diagnostic regressions and TypeScript test build pass. Positive fixture budgets remain bounded at the existing production default; classifier and coverage thresholds are unchanged. No failed CI result is treated as approval.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI phase diagnostics identify the remaining refusal as workspace-copy/Error, while matching local Bun consumers still pass. Artifact policy refusals now carry a stable category and workspace-relative artifact identity so CI can identify the rejected link without exposing absolute paths. The external-artifact refusal regression, test compilation and lint pass. The gate remains blocked pending that concrete result.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: CI identified the refused artifact as a Bun package download-cache symlink under .bun/install/cache. Added an exact-layout real-tracker regression: it fails before the fix (exit 1, assertion error) and now passes. Source snapshots exclude .bun, .npm and .cache alongside existing dependency/build caches; installed dependency bindings stay available, while external artifact links remain refused. Cache/dependency/artifact regressions pass 3/3; build:test, lint and zero duplication pass at unchanged thresholds. Final complete gates are restarting for this concrete fix.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Correction: the earlier statement that the PM-linked run passed 2/2 was based on the selected-command count, not its exit status. The saved progress log actually reports command 1 failed and command 2 passed. The latest PM-linked run likewise fails command 1, despite standalone and CI passes. Those PM-linked runs are not passing evidence. Investigating inherited source-context restrictions in nested execution, then rerunning and checking both process exit status and every command status. Original append-only receipts are retained.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The nested-run failure is confirmed trust_refusal: fixture command intake inherited the parent repository source root, so its metadata recorded the parent branch although its own tracker has no git. A regression forcing parent intake context failed before the fixture fix and now passes. Fixtures bind intake to their real workspace; production trust checks are unchanged and no untrusted-command override is used. The detached-child test also gives startup five seconds before triggering its cleanup deadline, while still requiring bounded termination; a loaded host previously killed the launcher before its pid file existed. Dedicated short-budget assertions and all coverage/classifier thresholds remain unchanged.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Verified final PM-linked run: process exit 0; both progress receipts explicitly report end status=passed and exit_code=0. Main integration command completed in 552937 ms; evidence-boundary command completed in 4757 ms. The verification script also asserted exactly two passed command receipts and no failed receipt. No timeout failures occurred. Durable run recording remains disabled by project policy, so this comment preserves the observed result. CI on ca837cc is green for Node 22/26 and full native Bun release gates; isolated-HOME npm gate is still running.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: The final isolated-HOME npm run on ca837cc exited 1: 154/155 source tests passed, zero skipped, all 26 authored sources still measured 100 percent in all four dimensions. value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Final complete isolated-HOME npm release:check on ca837cc with Node 26 exited 0. Outer source suite: 155 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped; all 26 authored sources met unchanged 100 percent statements/branches/functions/lines; duplication 0 percent; production audit 0 vulnerabilities. All later stages passed, including changelog and attestation checks and packed npm/npx plus native Bun/bunx acceptance 1/1. Three original merged-item copies remain unproven 2/2/16; the gamed seed is blocked. Known boundaries and failed-run corrections remain in linked docs and append-only history. Handing off for independent orchestrator review; item stays in progress and will not be closed.
